family_B_realized_range_ratio.hypothesis: Chop = compressed realized range. Entries taken while the session's realized range (at entry time) is far below the 20-day median for that same time-of-day cutoff fare worse.

family_B_realized_range_ratio.direction_note: Only the LOW side is tested (chop = compression). No high-side cell is pre-registered; none may be added post-hoc without a fresh prereg.

family_C_structure_timing.hypothesis: J's philosophy: structure shift at the zone, never chase. A day with no structure events yet, or a stale last event, is chop-state for a momentum/level engine.
